resources.string: On completing and skipping a set.
Your profile, plans and history, as one JSON file.
From a file this app exported. You will see what changes first.
Profile, plans and history. The exercise catalog stays.
This file has nothing in it.
That file could not be read.
That is not a RepForth export.
That file is from a newer version of RepForth.
That file is a RepForth export, but something in it is not valid.
Your profile, plans and history go. The exercise catalog and your settings stay. This cannot be undone.
Everything you have made, and your settings. The app returns to a fresh install. This cannot be undone.
Export first if you want to keep a copy.
Everything stays on this phone. No account, no upload, and no backup to anyone\'s servers.
Pick a provider and add your own API key. Optional — the built-in planner works without one.

RepForth has no server of its own. When you ask Coach for a workout, your request and a shortlist of exercises go straight from this phone to the provider you pick, using your own API key. What it costs and how long it is kept are between you and them.
A key is saved for this provider. It is encrypted on this phone, and cannot be shown again.
No key yet. Coach uses the built-in planner until you add one.
No key. Local servers like Ollama do not need one; a hosted service will ask for it.
That is not a web address.
Start the address with https:// — or http:// for a server on your own network.
Plain http:// is off. Turn on local model servers under Advanced to use one.
Plain http:// works only for an address on your own network, like 192.168.1.42. Anything on the internet needs https://.
Plain http:// needs the numeric address of a machine on your own network, like http://192.168.1.42:11434/v1/. Anything on the internet needs https://.
Do not put a username or password in the address.
Request timeout, and local model servers.
Lets plain http:// reach a model server on this device or on your own network, for tools like Ollama and LM Studio. Addresses on the internet stay https:// only, whatever this is set to.
Forgets the provider, the model, the address, and every saved key.
Every saved API key goes, along with the provider settings. Your workouts and history stay. This cannot be undone.
Connected, and the model is available.
Connected. This server does not list its models, so the model name could not be checked.
The provider rejected the key. Check that you pasted all of it and that it is still active.
Connected, but this model is not offered on your account. Check the model name.
Your provider account is rate limited or out of credit. Nothing to change here — that is between you and them.
Could not reach the provider. Check your connection, and the address if you typed one.
The provider answered with something this app could not read.
This app will not send to that address. Check the address above.
The provider is having trouble right now. Try again shortly.
